entities.name: Thyra Avis Mary Acres
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thyra Avis Mary Acres was a New Zealand artist, writer, illustrator and conservationist. She is best known for her comic strip about two pōhutukawa fairies, Hutu and Kawa.
